politeness: robots.txt is checked before every HTML page; >= 1.5 s between page requests and >= 1.0 s between API requests; descriptive User-Agent with a contact (EDA_CONTACT); public pages only, no login, no paywalled content.

robots_decisions.query.wikidata.org/sparql: disallowed (Disallow: /sparql) -> NOT used, although it would have been the richest structured source
robots_decisions.api.github.com: no robots.txt (404) -> allowed; documented REST API with a published rate limit

sources.urls: the English Wikipedia article of each tool (linked from the lists or the seed)
the English Wikipedia article of each tool's developer organisation
official product pages listed in data/metadata/seed_tools.json
official documentation landing pages listed in the seed (docs_url)
https://api.github.com/search/repositories over the EDA topics listed in the script; then, for kept repositories and only with GITHUB_TOKEN, /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest and /users/{owner}
fields: category (description/topics through the project's keyword rules)
country_region (owner's self-reported location, only when it names a country)
sources.note: Discovery source, mostly open-source tools. Filter rules are in the script header; every skipped repository and its reason is written to data/raw/github_topics_skipped_<date>.json.
